text:
elaine: Heads-up — pushing a small rate card patch (v3.1.1) to clarify commit crediting and trial credit expiry. Need quick 👀 from deal desk + finance so we can ship this Friday.
samir-sales: Thanks Elaine. Can you summarize the customer-facing delta? We need a short line for AE scripts.
tori-dealdesk: Pinged — quick Q: does this change how we net commits across product SKUs or just within the same SKU?
elaine: Good Q. Netting is within the same product family only (model API vs embeddings). No cross-product netting in this patch. We added explicit examples.
michelle-finance: Is there a cap on special-term credits when netting applies? Finance needs to know revenue recognition impact.
elaine: No new caps in v3.1.1 — same special-term limits apply. We added a note recommending deal-desk flagging any >6mo prepaid credits for AR treatment.
alec-legal: Share the proposed contract language snippet so we can check for ambiguity; worried about "netting" being interpreted as setoff.
elaine: Here is the snippet we plan to append to SOWs:

```
Commit Netting: For the avoidance of doubt, commit credits apply to usage within the same product family and SKU. Credits do not transfer between product families or third-party integrations. Any exceptional transfer requests require written approval from Redwood Inference deal desk.
```

samir-sales: AE script suggestion: "This update clarifies how commit credits are applied across our product families; it doesn't change your committed volume." keep it short.
tori-dealdesk: ok. We also need a follow-up line for legacy customers on grandfathering — do we auto-convert old commit tiers if they renew? @elaine
elaine: We added a small grandfathering paragraph: renewals within 90 days keep legacy tier rules; after that new ratecard applies. (Short term patch only.)
michelle-finance: Add: mark all grandfathered deals with tag `legacy_commit_v2`. Finance will export for GAAP review.
james-ops: Ops/billing note: need SKU map. Suggested mapping block for billing team:

```
old_sku: COMMIT-V2
new_sku: COMMIT-V3
netting_group: embeddings
```

james-ops: If you want ops to auto-apply credits we need the mapping in PROD by EOD Thursday.
elaine: Will drop mapping spreadsheet to #eng-ops and @james-ops in 10m.
michelle-finance: Also request deal-desk workflow: any special-term credit > $50k needs finance sign-off before approval.
tori-dealdesk: noted. We'll enforce via deal desk template.
deal-desk-bot: Please submit a Deal Desk request with label `ratecard-v3.1.1` and include: customer, sku, credit_amount, start_date, reason. Link: https://redwood/deal-desk/new :robot_face:
samir-sales: For customer comms: can we get a one-paragraph blurb to paste into renewal emails? @elaine
elaine: Draft in thread: "We updated our ratecard to clarify how commit credits apply across product families. This does not change your existing commitments. If you have questions, reply and we'll confirm how credits will be applied to your account." Use that unless inputs.
alec-legal: Looks fine but replace "confirm" with "document" to be precise.
elaine: Updated. Final ask: approve this wording + confirm finance tagging + ops mapping by EOD so we can ship Friday. :pray:
tori-dealdesk: Approve (subject to tag enforcement)
michelle-finance: Approve (will enforce finance sign-off for >$50k)
james-ops: Ops good, will ingest SKU map once posted.
samir-sales: Thumbs up from sales — will prep AE note.
deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk queue will block auto-approval until finance sign-off on requests >$50k"
